title: High cost and unacceptable issues
summary: Reviews in this topic criticize the G70 for being expensive while also citing unacceptable delays, water in headlights, and costly seat-related comfort system parts.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe high vehicle or parts cost alongside unacceptable wait times, headlight water intrusion, and expensive travel and comfort system brackets.

limitations: The sample is small and all examples are negative, so it does not show whether any offsetting positive or mixed experiences exist.
This topic combines pricing complaints with separate issues such as wait time, headlight water, and accessory part cost, so the cluster is not a single tightly focused problem.
